tips.title: Tips for Best Quality
tips.tip1: Lower distortion: Symmetric mode splits displacement between both eyes while preserving total binocular depth.
tips.tip2: 3D TVs (LG Cinema 3D / Samsung / Sony): Use Half-SBS format. On your TV remote, press 3D and select Side-by-Side.
tips.tip3: Meta Quest / VR Headsets: Use Full-SBS for maximum sharpness or MV-HEVC for Apple Vision Pro.
tips.tip4: Manual Retouching: Check Save Depth Map to edit tricky scenes in Photoshop/After Effects and re-export in seconds with Fast Re-export.
